dedupe_keys.name: flowmvgrid ml ready synthetic medium voltage grid data set

description: FlowMVGrid is a machine-learning-ready data set that combines real Dutch medium-voltage distribution network topologies with synthetic load profiles and full AC power flow results. It was published on IEEE DataPort by Nan Lin and Betül Mamudi to address the lack of benchmarks that pair realistic topology with time-varying load. Load profiles come from the GLASS data set at 15-minute resolution, and power flow labels were computed with the power-grid-model solver. It covers four grids of 57 to 878 nodes and over 141,000 samples, varied by topology, customer assignment, PV penetration, load level, time and measurement noise. Each sample is a compressed NumPy archive of loads, voltages, line flows and losses, with a graph file for PyTorch Geometric, four dataset classes for power flow, state estimation, forecasting and connection identification, validation checks and baseline results. Coverage is four Dutch networks. Files of about 2.1 GB are downloadable from IEEE DataPort after login, under CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: the page states that file access needs a login and shows a subscription notice, and loads are synthetic. Simulation uses are power flow surrogates and state estimation for distribution grids. Related records: model-power-grid-model is the solver used.
